$readme: Rules in CURRENT files that a later revision replaces. A diff check must apply these before flagging code. 'file' is relative to the bundle root. Newest wins.

overrides.stale: 'Seuil : 75%' text in --warning #F59E0B; sentence '2 absences avant avertissement.'; any client-side % cut-off
overrides.current: Server computes band ok|near|below (T, M=10, W=2, bestCase rule). Ring = overall band; sentence = worst subject ('{subject} : limite d'absences dépassée' / '{subject} : encore {n} absence(s) avant le seuil' / 'Toutes les matières au-dessus du seuil'). Text in --warning-text / --danger-text / --ink2.
overrides.note: Round 2 states phone and web must not disagree, so this also overrides any band/threshold logic in mobile Présence / Home specs and app/udj-presence.jsx.

overrides.current: --warning-text #9A5B06 / #F0A84B, --danger-text #C62828 / #FF6B6B; #F59E0B and #EF4444 are fills and strokes only
linear-gradient(155deg, #168666, #0F6E56) login; 150deg on GPA card; same in BOTH themes
tagline, GPA label and '/20' suffix #FFFFFF; language chip and mention badge bg rgba(0,0,0,.16); blobs/depth circle stay rgba(255,255,255,.07)

attendance.subject_below_threshold: '{subject} : limite d'absences dépassée — présence {rate} %, seuil {threshold} %' (rate truncated, U+202F before %); attendance.subject_near_threshold: '{subject} : encore {n} absence(s) avant la limite'. Sent on band transitions only.
